extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / editors (new or unautoconfirmed users)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for people attempting to create a new Wikipedia page: how to verify whether an article exists, requirements to create pages, and troubleshooting steps if a title is missing or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New users who are not logged in or not autoconfirmed cannot create articles; sign in or create an account and meet autoconfirmation criteria before attempting to create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the article directly (e.g., due to account status or uncertainty), submit a draft via the article wizard or make a request on the appropriate noticeboard so experienced editors can review/create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles and links for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Cracker Barrel (humor)" in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title. Please search for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, thoroughly search Wikipedia to ensure the topic isn't already covered under a different title, spelling, or as a section of another article; check for inbound links that imply coverage under another name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation visibility / cache delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the page was just created, wait briefly and/or use the purge function to refresh page listings; do not immediately re-create a page that may only be temporarily invisible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try alternative capitalizations (beyond the first letter) and, if you control the appropriate target page, add a redirect from the missing title instead of creating a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log and deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page does not exist because it was removed, consult the deletion log and deletion rationale to learn whether recreation is appropriate or whether content needs revision to meet Wikipedia policies before re-submitting.
